whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Knockout Fitness,

I noticed your gym has strong 4.5★ reviews in Rajendra Nagar, Patna, but your current Netlify demo page lacks an instant mobile booking system for trial sessions.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom high-converting website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, membership pricing plans (Monthly ₹2000 to Annual ₹9000), aur facility showcase integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://knockoutfit.netlify.app/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Knockout Fitness team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with your Rajendra Nagar location, membership pricing, and direct WhatsApp trial booking to help bring in more fitness enthusiasts. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
